takeaway: Methotrexate blocks utilization of folate. The main cause of deficiency is malnutrition; increased requirements (pregnancy, haemolysis) and malabsorption (coeliac) are other causes.

question.text: Which one of the following statements is true regarding folate deficiency?

lines.text: The main one is malnutrition, as in alcoholics, or from overcooked food.
Malabsorption, as in coeliac disease or Crohn disease, is another cause.
Requirements rise in pregnancy, malignancy and haemolysis.
And some drugs block folate use. Meet methotrexate, stopping folate at the door of the cell.
The result is a megaloblastic anaemia.
So the true statement: methotrexate blocks utilization of folate.
